charts/inflight.json, written by servtuner analyze for the Queueing tab: L(t), the client's requests in flight, sampled each second over the stages from the request records (each request from sent\_at for its E2E), and bucketed to at most 2000 points that keep each bucket's minimum and maximum; plus Little's law per stage. Warmup requests are left out.

Schema file: `schema/json/bundle/chart-inflight.schema.json`. Generated from servtuner commit `9fbc13619183`.

## Top level

| Field              | Type                                                                       | Required | Description                                                    |
| ------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `analyzer_version` | `string`                                                                   | Yes      |                                                                |
| `start`            | [utcTimestamp](/reference/schemas/common/#utctimestamp)                    | Yes      | The first stage's start; every offset is from here.            |
| `bucket_seconds`   | `integer`                                                                  | Yes      | Seconds per point: 1, widened to keep at most 2000 points. ≥ 1 |
| `stages`           | array of [littleCheck](/reference/schemas/chart-inflight/#littlecheck)     | Yes      |                                                                |
| `points`           | array of [inFlightPoint](/reference/schemas/chart-inflight/#inflightpoint) | Yes      |                                                                |

### littleCheck

Little's law L = λ × W for one stage: the mean in flight against arrival rate × mean E2E. A large error means the stage was not in steady state.

| Field                  | Type      | Required | Description                                             |
| ---------------------- | --------- | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| `stage_index`          | `integer` | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                     |
| `start_offset_seconds` | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                     |
| `end_offset_seconds`   | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                     |
| `arrival_rps`          | `number`  | Yes      | ≥ 0                                                     |
| `mean_e2e_seconds`     | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0                                                     |
| `mean_in_flight`       | `number`  | No       | ≥ 0                                                     |
| `little_error`         | `number`  | No       | \|mean in flight − λ × mean E2E\| ÷ (λ × mean E2E). ≥ 0 |
